description: Gold set of Alzheimer-disease repurposing connections that gained published support AFTER the run's time-slice cutoff (2019-12-31). Used for retrospective rediscovery recall (eval T1): a run restricted to pre-cutoff sources should surface these without having seen the direct claim. Illustrative set for the reference bundle.

entries.source: montelukast repurposing hypotheses and pilot studies reported 2020+
Fang et al., Nature Aging 2021 (PDE5 inhibitor association)
